title: Paste, modes, pictures, Russian
items: Paste an item copied in game into the search box: its card opens. A rare lists its modifiers with a trade search.
Play mode in the top bar: Trade, SSF, Hardcore or HC SSF. SSF and Hardcore hide prices; Hardcore puts danger first.
Quests, areas, runes, bosses, trial modifiers and odds pools show the game's own pictures.
The index in Russian, in GGG's own translations. Pick it at the foot of the page.
A price's 7-day move shows only on a real market. Joke listings show no price.

title: Runes, trials, and what each patch changed
items: Runes: a card for each rune, and a recipe finder. Bases show what the Verisium Anvil makes of them.
Achievements: a card for each, with the areas, bosses and items each step needs.
Trial modifiers and rare monster modifiers are cards, with what each one does to you.
Boss cards show the tell before each big hit, with its source.
Report a drop on unique, boss and area cards. A count shows once 3 reports agree.
NeverSink's filter tier on base and currency cards. The Currency page makes a loot filter block from today's prices.
Passive cards and the Patches page show what each patch changed, old and new, and what the patch notes left out.
Faster first search on phones.
The side index is gone. The respec cost folds out under the passive tree.

title: The odds, the campaign, the leagues
items: Odds: a card for each hidden roll pool, with every outcome and its chance. Pools link to what they can roll.
League mechanics link to their currency, atlas passives, tablets, bosses and odds, both ways.
The Atlas page ranks the league mechanics by their share of the Currency Exchange.
Areas and Waystones show a normal monster's life and damage at that level.
Gem popups show the gold price by level and quality.
Campaign: a new page, act by act. The areas, the quests and every reward kept for good, with ticks.
A shared card link shows its price and when it was checked.
The Data page lists the open data files and how to use them.

title: The world, the market, the patches
items: World: a card for every area, quest and act: where each area leads, who you fight there and what each quest gives.
Maps show what content they can hold, and what corrupting them can add.
Market: a new page with the price index, league start, rising fast, crafting demand, the league gap, patch shocks and weekly digests.
Currency cards show how easy they are to trade, their price by league day, and the hours they trade most.
Every card shows what each patch changed on it, in GGG's own words. Passives show when they were new, changed or renamed.
A Patches page lists every patch and hotfix with its date.
Every card popup says which patch its game data is from.

title: Know the fight
items: Boss cards show how hard each boss hits: its life, its defences and its big hits, worked out from the game files.
Keywords show the game's own numbers: culling thresholds, the party bonus and more.
Currency shows its Currency Exchange gold fee. Uniques show their gold value.
A respec calculator under the passive tree: gold a point at your level.
The map has a dot for every card, the Divine Orb and every boss included.

title: Where the market is
items: Currency: one count on every chip, wider market tiles, and all the filters in one row.
Trade says what you asked for in one short line.
Item prices that trade are checked every day. Things nobody lists are checked every week, so the searches go where the market is.
The price history keeps a copy of every day, even when a run starts late.

title: Sharper edges
items: Card buttons stay at the foot of the popup, and the arrows show only when there is a card to go back to.
Prices under 1 divine read in exalted everywhere. The Divine Orb shows its worth in exalted.
A lone spike no longer flattens a price chart. The chart says when it leaves one out.
"Tier 11" reads as 11. Each keyword is underlined once per card.
Pins stay after you close the tab.
Item pages say how long ago a price was checked, and every Runemastered unique links its plain version.

title: Find your way
items: Home shows the whole index under the search box, with counts. The chips come up once you type.
On a wide screen, the index runs down the side of every list.
The league clock counts minutes, and the crest sits higher.
Bosses opens on the bosses with drops.

title: The index, in sections
items: The top bar is the index: Items, Passives, Mechanics, Endgame, Economy, Craft and Data.
Every kind of card has its own list: bases, keywords, buffs, ascendancies, clusters and more.
A Data page: what the index holds, where it comes from, and how fresh it is.
On a phone, the menu holds the whole index, and the bar scrolls away with the page.

title: What's on your bar
items: Buffs and debuffs have their own cards: the icon, what it does, and what gives it.
Ascendancy cards, with every notable linked.
Uniques say which bosses drop them. Gems show their quality and the uncut gem that makes them.
Rare monster and waystone modifiers say what they do to you.
Passive text in GGG's own words.
League mechanics show their share of Currency Exchange trade. Hidden rolls show their odds.

title: Holding the line
items: When the market goes quiet, the Index holds its last prices and marks the hour they were taken.
Lighter on every visit, so the Index stays up when the crowds come.

title: Open to everyone
items: The Index is free to build on: CC BY 4.0. Name Wraeclast Index and link the page.
Every price on every page shows when it was checked. Item pages refresh every six hours.
A wrong address lands on the Index's own page, not a browser error.

title: Room to grow
items: Search answers off the page now, so the Index can grow without the site slowing down.
The home page opens on a sixth of the data it used to.
Item pages answer faster.

title: One top bar
items: One top bar on every page: Items, Passive tree, Endgame, Trade and Craft.
On a phone, one slim bar and a menu.
Suggest stays in reach, top right.

title: Straight from the game files
items: Gems, uniques, the passive tree and timeless jewels now come straight from the game files.
Passive lines read in the game's own order, and every node that grants a skill says so.
Uniques show their own properties. Crossbows show their reload time.
Fifteen more uniques. The Grand Spectrums read their own lines.
Anoint costs are live Currency Exchange prices, or none.

title: Every unique checked
items: Fifteen uniques that were never priced are now checked on their real base.

title: Lighter on any machine
items: Home is the search bar. Nothing under it until you type.
Search waits for the word, not every key. Long lists stop at 150, with Show more for the rest.
The Index loads when you reach for it. Gems, uniques and the passive tree open on the tab you asked for.
A tab you leave is put away, so a long session stays light.
The fog rests when nobody sees it. A weaker machine gets a still crest.
The fog weighs less and the cards answer the hand faster. Nothing looks different.
After an update, a return visit fetches only what changed.
A new price reaches your browser within minutes of landing, not hours.

title: Count your runs
items: The map answers: a dot gives its name and opens its card, and one is found by name with the same search that forgives a slip, so quaterstaff rings all 77 of them.
The map also says what it does not hold: 756 cards the site carries today have no dot on it.
Search forgives a slip. divien orb finds the Divine Orb, quaterstaff the Quarterstaff, simulcrum the Simulacrum.
Search reads every line of a card, not just its name. untold toll finds Bluetongue by its flavour line; fire resistance finds the runes that give it.
The Currency search and the bench search do the same: every word, anywhere on the row.
A run counter in the top bar. R counts one from anywhere, with a card open or not, and the key is yours to rebind.
It says how many, and how fast: 15 an hour, 12 over 44 min. The rate is measured off your own presses, never a published figure.
Take one off, or start over. Kept for the tab.
First piece of the farm tracker. What went in and what came out come next.

title: Ask the Currency page a question
items: Eight buttons over the Currency grid ask what a thing does instead of what its price did: changes an item, guarantees a modifier, sockets in and stays, adds quality, desecrates, opens a door, becomes a gem, supports a skill. The groups under them narrow to whatever is chosen.
Orb cards now show the whole upgrade ladder: what each step asks today, and the lowest modifier level it guarantees.
Runes, soul cores and idols read as a table — the slot on the left, what it gives there on the right — instead of one run-on line.
The crafting bench is one press from any currency card that can reach it.
The bench is one screen. Rolling no longer sends you to a second card, the drawer keeps your materials in hand, and more currency can come in mid-craft.
The bench has a search box. It searches every shelf at once, and Ctrl + / lands in it.
The busiest exchange markets now wear their art, both ends of every pair.
The Currency page leads with the currency. The busiest exchange markets moved below the grid, and the price buttons became one list beside the sort, so the cards start on the first screen.
A market says what it is priced in, so one currency's two markets no longer read as the same row twice.
A currency card now lists others that do this, cheapest first. 13 things add quality on a ring or amulet, over a 48× spread, and 13 more do it on a jewel.
The community campaign guide moved to the front page.

title: Worth it
items: Bosses now say whether a kill is worth it: what the way in costs, what the kill returns as a range, and how many kills before that range means anything.
3,819 places the game's own wording points at an interaction are mapped. 516 open a card; the rest are marked unclear, beside what players report.
Any card can be pinned. The list stays while the tab is open.
Base items carry a price.
Price charts reach back through past leagues, from poe.ninja, marked with theirs.
Search leans toward the kinds of card you have been opening.
Build and Farms are closed for rebuilding. Farms comes back as your own farm: what you put in, what you got out, counted over your runs.

title: The crafting bench
items: The crafting bench: a base, the currency and omens on it, and the pool it rolls from. Every roll comes off the real pool, with how often each one lands named where it is shown. A craft you leave is still there after a refresh.
Every card you can craft with carries a way to the bench: bases, orbs, essences, omens, runes, catalysts and bones.
A base card now says what it can roll and what a corruption can add. Gloves carry a Stonefist switch.
Trade: a chosen base narrows the mods, the defence types and the sliders to what that base can have. One tap clears it.
Item classes are cards of their own: Gloves, Boots, Quarterstaves and 28 more, each with every base under it.
32 more keyword cards, and every keyword card now says what uses it.
The Build tab links a community campaign guide by domistae.
How damage works and how defences work are now a sword and a shield beside the name, instead of two blocks across the card.

title: Every card, connected
items: Bosses: 104 of them, what they drop, and the live price of the way in. Rates where a real sample exists, with the source named.
Cards remember where you have been: back and forward through 50 steps, with hotkeys, and a card comes back exactly as you left it.
Words in a card's lines now open their own card. 21,324 of them across 5,500 cards.
Essences say what they add on each kind of item.
Craft: how often each mod rolls on a base, likeliest first.
Currency: search all 661 and star any of them, grouped by family.
893 small passives and every conqueror are searchable.
New mechanics cards: how damage works, with the order it is worked out in.
Price charts show this league and the three before it, each past league dashed in its own colour.
Cards fit a phone properly, and nothing scrolls sideways.

title: Cards that stay put
items: Cards no longer close when you tap, drag or select text inside them.
On a phone the card fills the screen, so there is far less dead space to mis-tap.
Escape while typing clears the box instead of closing the card.
Cleaner card text: 197 leftover lines of game code removed from unique items.
Page notes rewritten.

title: Faster
items: Search, Gems, Uniques and Passive tree open much quicker.
Repeat visits open instantly.
Nothing jumps around while a page loads.
Trade prices fill in every hour again.

title: The whole game in one search
items: New menu: two groups with small icons. Search, Build, Trade, Farms, then Craft, Currency, Passive tree, Uniques, Gems, Atlas.
Every base item (1,554 weapons, armour pieces, jewellery, jewels, flasks and charms) now has a card, with Trade and Open in Craft.
Atlas passives, waystones, tablets and keys are in the search too.
Keyword cards now list bases and essences.
Lineage gems are marked Lineage.
New Privacy page.

title: Real prices only
items: Currency prices come straight from the in-game Currency Exchange, every hour.
Unique prices come from live trade site listings, with when they were checked.
The Currency tab shows the busiest exchange markets.
Farms no longer shows a cost total: the sheet has no amounts.
Keyword cards list everything that uses them, in order: uniques, gems, every passive, atlas, crafting mods, currency and keywords.

title: Keywords and Crafting
items: Every keyword shows what uses it: uniques, gems, passives, atlas and currency.
Gems, Uniques and Passive tree rows open full cards with Trade and prices.
New Craft tab: every mod a base can roll, and what each crafting method adds.

title: Live prices, Farms and Atlas
items: Trade sliders show what rolls really cost, updated every hour.
New Farms and Atlas tabs.
League countdown on the home page.
Popular searches, a Suggest button and faster pages.
Build tab reads Mobalytics links.

title: New look
items: Forged bronze frames, like the crest.
Tier marks on every trade slider.
Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield boxes for gear.

title: Keys and art
items: Keybindings open on ?. Ctrl + / searches the list you are on.
Game art on every card.

title: Trade search
items: A Trade page that speaks human.
A Trade button on every card.

title: A home of its own
items: wraeclastindex.fyi, the poison theme and a search box on every page.

title: The beginning
items: Every gem, unique and passive, straight from the game files.
